heroLead: Rowes Run is a small community in Fayette County, and like a lot of the smaller places we cover in this part of the state, most of the mineral interests here trace back to a handful of family farms that got divided over the decades into the parcels people own today.
intro: We don't get a lot of questions from Rowes Run about big multi-well units — this is a quieter corner of Fayette County, and owners here are usually more focused on simply understanding what they have and what it's genuinely worth, without a lot of noise around it.

sections.heading: A Straight Answer on What Your Interest Is Worth
paragraphs: We check current leasing and drilling activity near Rowes Run before quoting anything, and if that activity is limited compared to the busier parts of Washington or Greene County, we'll tell you that honestly rather than inflating an offer to get you to sign. Our reputation depends on giving accurate numbers, not the biggest number.
If your interest is under an existing lease with some royalty history, even modest, that gives us a firmer basis to work from than an unleased tract with nothing to compare against.

sections.heading: Confirming Title Before Anything Else
paragraphs: We pull the recorded deed chain from the Fayette County recorder of deeds in Uniontown to confirm exactly what you own, especially important for smaller communities like Rowes Run where original farm tracts were sometimes divided informally among family members without every step being recorded promptly.

faqs.question: Is Rowes Run in an active area for gas leasing?
faqs.answer: Activity here is generally lighter than in the busiest parts of Fayette or neighboring counties. We check your specific location and give you an honest read.

faqs.question: What if I'm not sure exactly what I own?
faqs.answer: We trace the recorded deed history for you as part of a free review, at no cost or obligation.

faqs.question: Will you pressure me to sell quickly?
faqs.answer: No. We give you our offer and the reasoning behind it, and you decide on your own timeline.

faqs.question: Is it worth getting an offer even if I'm not sure I want to sell?
faqs.answer: Yes, plenty of Rowes Run owners just want a clear number to understand what they hold, with no obligation to move forward afterward.

faqs.question: How far do you check for nearby activity when quoting a quiet area like this?
faqs.answer: We typically look at the closest producing units within several miles of your parcel, since that's usually the most reliable signal for a quieter part of Fayette County.
